ÉLAN / THE FIRST EDITION

From the first welcome
to the final applause.

A stage, two competitive arenas and the people who brought them to life. This is a look inside the first Élan Summit at SGIS Pune Campus, Mulshi. Here are the sessions and the moments around them.

105PARTICIPANTS
10SCHOOLS
2DAYS TOGETHER
DAY / 01

5 September 2026

The first move.
01

DAY ONE / OPENING CEREMONY

The first
welcome.

Before the committee rooms, everyone came together. Performances and addresses opened the summit, introducing the people and ideas that would shape the next two days.

On stage: a performance from the first day.

02

DAY ONE / COMMITTEE SESSIONS

The discussions
begin.

The focus shifted from the stage to the table. Across Crisis Command and Cent$ible, participants listened, exchanged ideas and worked through the decisions in front of them.

Around the table: listening, exchanging views and working as a team.

Explore Crisis Command ↗Explore Cent$ible ↗
03

DAY ONE / DJ NIGHT

After the sessions,
the music.

The conversations gave way to music. DJ night brought people together on the dance floor for a shared celebration after a day spent in different rooms.

DAY / 02

6 September 2026

Carry it forward.
04

DAY TWO / COMMITTEE SESSIONS

Back at
the table.

Day 2 brought participants back to their respective arenas. Teams picked up the work of the first day, continuing their discussions and preparing for the concluding stages.

A delegation photographed together during the second day.

05

DAY TWO / CLOSING CEREMONY

One last
gathering.

The summit returned to a shared stage for its closing ceremony: a chance to reflect on the two days and acknowledge the people behind them.

From the Day 2 collection: an address on stage.

06

AWARDS & FELICITATIONS

A moment
of recognition.

The final chapter made space for achievement and contribution. Awards and felicitations brought participants and the people supporting them into the spotlight.

A presentation on stage, captured during Day 2.

THE FIRST CHAPTER IS PART OF OUR STORY.

The next one
is still being written.
